observation: In ProposalValidator, when checking source findings, only findings with status VALIDATED were accepted. If a finding had been moved to the consolidated/ directory (status CONSOLIDATED), it was rejected. However, ProposalTransitionManager::approve explicitly accepted CONSOLIDATED source findings, creating an inconsistency that caused proposal approvals for consolidated findings to always roll back.

evidence.summary: The test failed because ProposalValidator threw a ValidationException stating the source finding was not validated. Changing the status check to accept both VALIDATED and CONSOLIDATED solved the issue.

hypothesis: Once findings are consolidated into a proposal, they transition to CONSOLIDATED status, which represents a verified state of evidence. Thus, they must still be recognized as valid evidence for any proposal that depends on them.
validated_conclusion: When validating the source findings of a proposal in ProposalValidator, accept both VALIDATED and CONSOLIDATED finding statuses as valid evidence references.
